# Website relaunch

The company website moves to a new platform before the end of the year. Goals: faster pages, a cleaner navigation, and a content model the editors can maintain without a developer. The agency delivers the templates in November; our team migrates the legacy articles and redirects.

Workstreams and notes:

- [[Relaunch kickoff]] sets the scope and the roles
- [[Relaunch risks]] lists what can slip
- [[Relaunch budget]] tracks the agency invoices and the hosting costs
- [[Stakeholder map]] shows who decides what

Weekly status goes to the steering group every Thursday.
